blockers.message: Operator profile signed out of Alibaba on https://www.alibaba.com/ (Sign In prompt visible, no account menu). Inline auth-signin/alibaba recovery via login.alibaba.com -> Continue with Google -> Dieter Google chooser row succeeded up to the OAuth return, but Alibaba then served the identity-verification interstitial at https://login.alibaba.com/iv/verify_mode.htm?htoken=... (phone/SMS or alternate verification required). Identity verification cannot be solved by automation; operator must complete it manually in the persistent Chrome at /Users/alinaaitova/.chrome-automation, after which marketplace-search/alibaba can be re-run.

search_results.evidence: Step 1 title check on https://www.alibaba.com/ returned 'Alibaba.com: Manufacturers, Suppliers, Exporters & Importers from the world's largest online B2B marketplace' but DOM probe reported hasSignInPrompt=true, hasMyAlibaba=false, no [class*=account-menu] element. Step 1a recovery: login.alibaba.com loaded without slide CAPTCHA; Continue-with-Google clicked via attr-customurl path; landed on accounts.google.com chooser; Dieter row clicked (page_shape=chooser_target_found); poll returned status=identity_verification_required, url=https://login.alibaba.com/iv/verify_mode.htm?htoken=af856cd...d8c9.
